title: Dallas-KC Energy Conference: Policy Accommodative, Could Hike Faster This Winter
summary: In a full outlook speech on the morning of a hotter-than-expected October CPI, Logan keeps the destination she set on October 30 ('at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases', then pause) but sharpens both the diagnosis and the pace. She now calls policy outright accommodative ('accommodative monetary policy is adding to inflationary pressures'), with the real funds rate about 78 basis points, below the lowest of eight model estimates of neutral, and financial conditions a tailwind. New versus Davidson: she opens the door to speed ('It may be possible to move more rapidly this winter than the FOMC has moved so far this fall'), flags that October PCE could rise after the CPI surprise, argues the Dallas trimmed mean understates the trend, and adds a second-round risk from firms planning 2027 pay rises to offset 2026 inflation. Energy is treated as a fading level shock, but she warns against being 'too eager to call shocks temporary' in an era of frequent conflicts, while broad core-services inflation, strong AI-led investment and a labor market at maximum employment and tightening carry the case.

key_quotes.quote: In my view, accommodative monetary policy is adding to inflationary pressures.
key_quotes.context: Her read of the current stance, backed by a real funds rate below the lowest neutral estimate.

key_quotes.quote: It may be possible to move more rapidly this winter than the FOMC has moved so far this fall.
key_quotes.context: New versus Oct. 30: after defending the October skip, she opens the door to a faster pace of hikes.

key_quotes.quote: I am concerned that PCE inflation could rise when we receive those data for October in a couple of weeks.
key_quotes.context: Reaction to the October CPI released that morning, which came in above expectations.

key_quotes.quote: It remains clear to me, given the current outlook, that the FOMC needs to implement at least two more 25-basis-point rate increases.
key_quotes.context: Destination unchanged from Oct. 30: at least two more hikes before pausing to reassess.
